name: White NICU Nurse Retractable Badge Reel
seoTitle: NICU Nurse Badge Reel, Gift for Neonatal Nurses
metaDescription: A white NICU badge reel for neonatal intensive care nurses who want their unit on their ID. A simple, thoughtful gift for a new or seasoned NICU nurse.
summary: A clean white badge reel that names the NICU, a small way to celebrate the nurses who care for the tiniest patients.
whyItWorks: NICU nurses tend to be proud of their specialty, and for good reason. Their days revolve around tiny patients, anxious parents, and a lot of careful hands on work. A badge reel that spells out the unit is a small nod to that identity. It sits right on the chest or pocket where parents and coworkers see it, and the white color keeps it clean and simple next to soft scrubs or a unit jacket.

Gift buyers often struggle to find something that feels specific to the NICU without being cutesy. A unit reel solves that. It is easy to buy in multiples for a whole night shift crew, a welcome bag for a new grad starting in the NICU, or a preceptor thank you. The retractable cord and alligator clip handle the constant badge taps at locked doors and med stations, which happen many times a shift.
goodToKnow: Look at the listing photos to see the exact design and lettering before ordering.
Buying several at once makes an easy matching gift for a NICU team.
Pair it with a card or a coffee gift card for a fuller present.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a new NICU nurse?
faq.a: Yes, it is a nice way to welcome someone to the unit and celebrate landing a NICU job. It is small enough to give alongside a card without feeling over the top.

faq.q: Does it work for ICU nurses outside the NICU?
faq.a: The design names the neonatal unit specifically, so it is best for nurses who work in the NICU. For adult ICU nurses, look for a reel with ICU or general nurse artwork instead.
